news.headline: Hundreds evacuate after Russian strike on depot near Kyiv kills at least 37
news.summary: A Russian drone strike on a depot on the outskirts of Ukraine's capital Kyiv on Friday killed at least 37 people and forced hundreds to evacuate, Ukrainian authorities said Saturday.

news.headline: US to control one fifth of Venezuela's oil reserves, Trump says
news.summary: President Donald Trump on Friday announced an unprecedented US push ​to take control of a fifth of Venezuela's vast oil reserves, betting that American companies can revive the OPEC nation's battered energy industry while delivering a new source of crude to help bring down US fuel prices.

news.headline: Russian strikes hit homes, warehouse, shopping mall across Ukraine
news.summary: A Russian drone strike triggered a major fire and explosions at a warehouse on the outskirts of Ukraine's capital Kyiv, forcing hundreds to evacuate the region, authorities said early Saturday.
